leadText: A group of nameless s who participate in the Battle Royal have made minor recurring appearances in Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. They first appeared in Pushing the Fiery Envelope! and later made another appearance in A Young Royal Flame Ignites!.
plainText:
A group of nameless s who participate in the Battle Royal have made minor recurring appearances in Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. They first appeared in Pushing the Fiery Envelope! and later made another appearance in A Young Royal Flame Ignites!.

==Primarina Trainer==
 
This female Trainer first appeared in Pushing the Fiery Envelope!. She battled and two other Trainers in a Battle Royal, but lost to the Masked Royal when he used his 's Z-Move to defeat all of its three opponents.

She appeared again in A Young Royal Flame Ignites!, where she participated in another Battle Royal against the Trainer, the Trainer, and one of the Revengers with his . The outcome of the battle is unknown.
